"""Guard and normally allocate the existing b slot to root; no extra reviewer."""
import json,sys
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
from tools.fresh_source_observation_queue import claim as fresh_claim
from tools.portrait_review_queue import wait_for_claim
phase_path=ROOT/'runtime/root-b-review-v15-phase.json';phase=read_json(phase_path)
assert phase['machine_id']==machine_id() and phase['current_tag'] is None
assert phase['completed_groups']<phase['max_groups'] and datetime.now(timezone.utc)<datetime.fromisoformat(phase['deadline_utc'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
run=phase['run_id'];assert read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json')=={'run_id':run,'machine_id':machine_id()}
assert read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json')['status']=='running'
assert not (ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/handoff-stop.json').exists() and not (ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}-stop-requested.json').exists()
assert read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/slot-b.json')['status']=='available'
allocation=fresh_claim(ROOT,'b')
if allocation.get('ready'):
 views=[]
 for item in allocation['sources']:
  with Image.open(item['original']) as opened:image=opened.convert('RGBA')
  target=ROOT/f'runtime/{allocation["tag"]}-{item["key"][:8]}-root-nearest4.png'
  assert not target.exists();image.resize((image.width*4,image.height*4),Image.Resampling.NEAREST).save(target)
  views.append({'key':item['key'],'path':item['original'],'sha256':item['original_png_sha256'],'size':list(image.size),'alpha_extrema':list(image.getchannel('A').getextrema()),'nearest_path':str(target),'nearest_sha256':file_sha256(target)})
 allocation.update(views=views,mascot_reference_sha256=file_sha256(ROOT/'mod_nailong/assets/reference/naiwa.png'));kind='originals'
else:
 assert not allocation.get('stop_requested')
 allocation=wait_for_claim('b',0);kind='portrait'
if allocation.get('ready'):
 phase.update(current_tag=allocation['tag'],current_kind=kind,allocated_at_utc=utc_now());write_json(phase_path,phase)
print(json.dumps({'kind':kind,'allocation':allocation,'finite_phase':phase},ensure_ascii=True))

"""Independent current source/raw/ordered builtin request verification, no approval."""
import hashlib,json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
tag=sys.argv[1];assert re.fullmatch(r'rollingb[0-9]+',tag)
slot=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/slot-b.json');assert slot['status']=='assigned' and slot['tag']==tag and slot['machine_id']==machine_id()
owner=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json');assert owner=={'run_id':'resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v15','machine_id':machine_id()}
assert read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{owner["run_id"]}.json')['status']=='running'
assert not (ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/handoff-stop.json').exists() and not (ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{owner["run_id"]}-stop-requested.json').exists()
manifest=ROOT/slot['manifest'];assert file_sha256(manifest)==slot['manifest_sha256']
out=ROOT/f'runtime/root-review-slot-b/{tag}';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
entries=[];reference=ROOT/'mod_nailong/assets/reference/naiwa.png';reference_sha=file_sha256(reference)
rows=read_json(ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/generated.json')['portraits']
for page in read_json(manifest)['pages']:
 assert file_sha256(Path(page['path']))==page['sha256']
 for e in page['entries']:
  key=e['source_sha256'];source=ROOT/f'runtime/references/{key}.png';raw=ROOT/e['generated_fullsize_image'];row=rows[key]
  assert file_sha256(source)==e['original_png_sha256'] and file_sha256(raw)==e['generated_fullsize_sha256']==row['generated_fullsize_sha256']
  assert file_sha256(ROOT/row['image'])==e['image_sha256']==row['image_sha256']
  journal=ROOT/row['request_journal'];a=next(v for v in read_json(journal)['attempts'] if v['number']==e['attempt_number'])
  assert a['method']=='built-in imagegen' and a['fullsize_sha256']==e['generated_fullsize_sha256']
  dispatch=ROOT/f'runtime/production-queue/dispatch/{key}-{a["number"]:03}.json';d=read_json(dispatch)
  assert d['status']=='returned_image' and d['returned_image_sha256']==e['generated_fullsize_sha256']
  snapshot=Path(d['actual_request_snapshot_file']);assert file_sha256(snapshot)==d['actual_request_snapshot_sha256']==a['actual_request_verification']['actual_request_snapshot_sha256']
  s=read_json(snapshot);assert s['key']==key and s['prompt']==a['prompt'] and hashlib.sha256(s['prompt'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()==d['prompt_sha256']==a['prompt_sha256']
  assert s['transparent']==a['transparent_background'] and a['actual_request_verification']['actual_recorded_before_call'] is True
  paths=s.get('references',s.get('referenced_image_paths',[]));ordered=[file_sha256(Path(p)) for p in paths]
  assert ordered==d['input_sha256'] and ordered[-1]==reference_sha and e['original_png_sha256'] in ordered
  assert file_sha256(Path(d['returned_image']))==e['generated_fullsize_sha256']
  with Image.open(source) as im:si=im.convert('RGBA')
  with Image.open(raw) as im:ri=im.convert('RGBA')
  nearest=out/f'{e["index"]}-source-nearest4.png';si.resize((si.width*4,si.height*4),Image.Resampling.NEAREST).save(nearest)
  def stats(im):
   alpha=im.getchannel('A');hist=alpha.histogram()
   return {'size':list(im.size),'alpha_extrema':list(alpha.getextrema()),'alpha_counts_252_255':{str(k):hist[k] for k in [252,253,254,255]}}
  entries.append({**e,'source_image':source.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'source_stats':stats(si),'raw_stats':stats(ri),'source_nearest4':nearest.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'source_nearest4_sha256':file_sha256(nearest),'journal_sha256':file_sha256(journal),'dispatch_sha256':file_sha256(dispatch),'actual_snapshot_sha256':file_sha256(snapshot),'exact_prompt_sha256':a['prompt_sha256'],'ordered_input_sha256':ordered,'transparent':s['transparent'],'retained_builtin_cache_sha256':file_sha256(Path(d['returned_image'])),'binding_verified':True})
target=out/'verified-binding.json'
write_json(target,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'verified_at_utc':utc_now(),'observer':'Codex root, existing b slot takeover; no new reviewer slot','manifest':slot['manifest'],'manifest_sha256':file_sha256(manifest),'reference_sha256':reference_sha,'entries':entries,'scope':'Fresh independent byte/request verification only, no visual decision or canonical write. Root must actually view required original/raw/matte evidence independently.'})
print(json.dumps({'proof':target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'proof_sha256':file_sha256(target),'entries':len(entries),'all_ordered_builtin_bindings_verified':True,'raw_alpha_extrema':[e['raw_stats']['alpha_extrema'] for e in entries]},ensure_ascii=True))

Stage/global/complete already succeeded once. Sole running builtin producer applies decisions between imports; all original/raw PNGs remain unchanged.'})
write_json(phase_path,phase)
print(json.dumps({'tag':tag,'counts':body['counts'],'completed_groups':phase['completed_groups'],'audit':target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()},ensure_ascii=True))
